title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Training Notes — Refund of Instant Cashout Fees
content:
## The rule

On Cartwise Shopper Payouts a cashout fee is refunded in full, and never in part, in either of two cases:

- with the refund reason "cashout returned", when its cashout came back as a returned transfer on the account and the plan refunds the fee on a returned or failed cashout;
- with the refund reason "late arrival", when the plan's late-refund figure in business days is above 0 and the cashout arrived later than that many business days after its date.

Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays. A fee of 0.00 is never refunded. Each fee entry is refunded at most once.

## Questions answered by the rule

Which fee is refunded? The fee entry that belongs to the cashout in question on the same payout account. The refund is tied to that fee entry, and the account's own entries show whether that fee entry has already been refunded; once it has, it is not refunded again.

How much is refunded? The whole fee of that entry. No partial refund exists.

When does the returned-cashout reason apply? When the account records show the cashout came back as a returned transfer, and the plan's terms provide a fee refund on a returned or failed cashout. The shopper's account of the cashout having failed is not the evidence; the returned-transfer entry is.

When does the late-arrival reason apply? Only on a plan whose late-refund figure is above 0; on a plan where that figure is 0 the late-arrival reason does not apply. On such a plan it applies when the arrival came later than that number of business days after the cashout date.

What about a cashout whose fee was 0.00? Nothing is refunded; a fee of 0.00 is never refunded.

## Worked cases (hypothetical plan with a late-refund figure of 2 business days, fee 0.50)

| Cashout date | Arrival date | Business days after the cashout date | Late-arrival refund? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday 2 March | Wednesday 4 March | 2 | No — not later than 2 business days |
| Monday 2 March | Thursday 5 March | 3 | Yes — 0.50 refunded in full |
| Friday 6 March | Tuesday 10 March | 2 (Saturday and Sunday not counted) | No |

(The hypothetical dates above assume no US federal holiday falls in the span.)

A second request to refund the same 0.50 fee entry after it has been refunded once is not granted: each fee entry is refunded at most once.
